description: A pulse oscillator that makes four pulses in every cycle, with the two breakpoints setting where they fall

params.text: Sets the pitch, -8 to 4 as a power of two around middle C, which is about 1Hz to 4186Hz
Scales the voltage at the FM jack, 0 to 300 per cent
While on, the FM jack is added to the frequency in hertz rather than to the pitch in octaves, which gives through-zero frequency modulation
Sets where in the cycle the third pulse falls, 0.01 to 0.98
Attenuates the voltage at the jack above it before it is added to the first breakpoint knob, 0 to 0.1 per volt
Sets where the second and fourth pulses fall against the first and third, 0.01 to 0.98
Attenuates the voltage at the jack above it before it is added to the second breakpoint knob, 0 to 0.1 per volt

inputs.text: Sets the pitch by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Modulates the frequency through the FM knob; with Lin off it is added to the pitch in octaves, and with Lin on it is added to the frequency itself, which lets it pass through zero
Modulates that breakpoint, scaled by the knob below it
Modulates that breakpoint, scaled by the knob below it

notes: the wave is worked out sixteen times over per sample and filtered, which keeps the hard pulse edges from aliasing

inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 0.98V.
inputs.3:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 0.98V.
